comment: Byte budgets for what every conversation pays for when it loads the connector (improvement list M2). tools/list is sent once per conversation; diagram_capabilities and worksheet_capabilities are read before a family's first use, and their text content is what a model reads (the same JSON also travels as structuredContent). Sizes are UTF-8 bytes of the JSON. Measured 14 Nov 2026 on main 657aee1: tools/list 69,974 bytes (create_worksheet 28,927, create_booklet 20,005); longest description create_booklet, 3,867 characters; capabilities text bar-model 50,748, graph 44,052, triangle 38,497, cuboids 20,334, probability-tree 13,874, ratio-table 13,405, every other family under 12,000; worksheet_capabilities 4,836. Each budget has about 5% headroom. Lower a budget when a change makes the catalogue smaller; raising one needs a reason in this comment and in the pull request.
